name: Polestar Automotive Holding UK PLC
note: Swedish EV maker listed on Nasdaq (PSNY). Largest holders per its 20-F for 2025: Li Shufu 55.2% of shares via PSD Investment, Snita and Geely vehicles; PSD controls 27.9% of votes; the PSD/Snita/Geely group holds 52.9% of voting power. Volvo Cars holds approximately 19.9% (via Snita Holding B.V.), Geely Sweden Automotive Investment B.V. approximately 11.6%. sec.gov, polestar.com
